description: List pending alert-review runs as root-cause groups with batch-action preview, rather than row-by-row noisy alert triage.

includeRuns.description: Whether to include compact matching run rows in the response.

maxScan.description: Maximum pending-review rows to scan before grouping. Defaults to 1000 (the dashboard count), the maximum.

rootCauseKey.description: Optional root-cause group key to filter to one group.

search.description: Optional search over rule, route, IP, evidence, or proposed guard.

name: securenow_alert_review_runs_list
title: List Alert Review Root Causes
